gameName: Monster Crunch! The Breakfast Battle Game
firstPlayerRule: The person who most recently ate a real bowl of cereal starts the first round.
clarifications: The last player remaining in a round starts the next round.
The player who ran out of cards in the previous hand starts the next hand.
